negative.name: flip_segment_digest
negative.rule: segment_digest = D('seal', canonical seal), one hex digit flipped

negative.name: flip_projection_root
negative.rule: projection_root = D('rows', canonical rows), one hex digit flipped in the seal

negative.name: flip_event_head
negative.rule: seal.event_head is the head of the segment's last event

negative.name: flip_manifest_digest
negative.rule: manifest_digest = D('manifest', canonical body), one hex digit flipped

negative.name: flip_last_segment_digest
negative.rule: manifest.last_segment_digest is the last segment_digest (manifest re-hashed)

negative.name: duplicate_segment_index
negative.rule: each segment has its own events: segment 0 repeated as segment 1

negative.name: unsorted_rows
negative.rule: rows are sorted by their canonical JSON bytes

negative.name: signature_not_null
negative.rule: signature is reserved and null in v1 (outside every digest)

negative.name: noncanonical_whitespace
negative.rule: a file is exactly its canonical JSON bytes: no whitespace

negative.name: noncanonical_key_order
negative.rule: a file is exactly its canonical JSON bytes: keys sorted

negative.name: manifest_extra_key
negative.rule: manifest keys are exactly the six of section 5

negative.name: record_not_object
negative.rule: a rows record is an object

negative.name: record_unknown_table
negative.rule: a rows record names a projection table

negative.name: json_escaped_slash
negative.rule: slash is written bare, never escaped

negative.name: json_escaped_ascii_letter
negative.rule: a printable ASCII character is never a unicode escape

negative.name: json_uppercase_unicode_escape
negative.rule: unicode escape hex digits are lowercase

negative.name: json_raw_non_ascii
negative.rule: a file is ASCII: non-ASCII is escaped, never raw UTF-8

negative.name: json_non_ascii_value
negative.rule: lowercase escapes and a surrogate pair parse as canonical, but no v1 field holds such text
